description: Time your bedtime or alarm to 90-minute sleep cycles so you wake up between cycles, feeling refreshed.

faqs.a: Average sleep cycles last about 90 minutes, but real cycles range from 80 to 120 minutes and vary by person and night. The times are smart starting points, not guarantees.
faqs.q: Is every sleep cycle exactly 90 minutes?

faqs.a: Waking mid-cycle — especially out of deep sleep — causes grogginess. Waking at the end of a cycle, during light sleep, usually feels easier.
faqs.q: Why wake at the end of a cycle?

faqs.a: Yes — switch to 'I am going to sleep now' and it gives wake-up times 4, 5 and 6 full cycles ahead, including 15 minutes to fall asleep.
faqs.q: Can it tell me when to set my alarm if I sleep now?

howto: Choose a mode: wake up at a set time, or sleep now.
For a set time: enter when your alarm rings.
Pick a bedtime from the 3–6 cycle options.
For sleep-now mode: choose one of the suggested wake-up times.
title: Sleep Cycle Calculator
